_comment: Pushed as a pinned, undeletable TOP SECRET dispatch when a fail state triggers. Keys: revolution | coup | collapse | dynastic_collapse.

revolution.subject: CRITICAL ALERT: SYSTEM PURGE — ARMED REVOLUTION
revolution.headline: GOVERNMENT FALLEN: ARMED REVOLUTION.
revolution.body:
CRITICAL ALERT. THIS MESSAGE IS GENERATED AUTOMATICALLY.

As of {date}, civil order in the {nation} has ceased to exist.

Armed revolutionary committees have seized the rail yards, the radio masts and the Parliament in {capital}. Gendarmerie units have deserted or joined the crowds. The office of the {leader_title} has been declared dissolved by a Provisional Council.

Under Protocol ZERO this terminal is being purged. All command authority is revoked. Cryptographic keys are being destroyed.

There is no further action available.

>> SESSION TERMINATED <<

coup.subject: CRITICAL ALERT: SYSTEM PURGE — MILITARY COUP
coup.headline: GOVERNMENT FALLEN: MILITARY COUP.
coup.body:
CRITICAL ALERT. THIS MESSAGE IS GENERATED AUTOMATICALLY.

At 0340 on {date}, armored units of the Aldmark garrison surrounded the Chancellery. A 'Council of National Salvation' composed of senior officers has announced over state radio that the {leader_title} has been relieved of office 'for the good of the nation'.

Your protection detail has been disarmed. Loyalist commanders are not answering.

Under Protocol ZERO this terminal is being purged. All command authority is revoked. Cryptographic keys are being destroyed.

There is no further action available.

>> SESSION TERMINATED <<

collapse.subject: CRITICAL ALERT: SYSTEM PURGE — STATE INSOLVENCY
collapse.headline: GOVERNMENT FALLEN: STATE COLLAPSE.
collapse.body:
CRITICAL ALERT. THIS MESSAGE IS GENERATED AUTOMATICALLY.

As of {date}, the Treasury of the {nation} has defaulted on all obligations.

Civil servants have not been paid. Soldiers have not been paid. Foreign creditors have seized our gold reserves and our shipping. Ministries have stopped answering. Provincial governors in the east have begun negotiating with the Vosk Hegemony directly.

The state no longer functions. Under Protocol ZERO this terminal is being purged. All command authority is revoked.

There is no further action available.

>> SESSION TERMINATED <<

dynastic_collapse.subject: CRITICAL ALERT: PROTOCOL ZERO — DYNASTIC COLLAPSE
dynastic_collapse.headline: GOVERNMENT FALLEN: DYNASTIC COLLAPSE.
dynastic_collapse.body:
CRITICAL ALERT. THIS MESSAGE IS GENERATED AUTOMATICALLY.

As of {date}, the ruling House of the {nation} has ceased to hold power.

There is no member of the blood left to take the oath of the {leader_title}, or the office has been seized by force from within the family. The Guards regiments have sealed the palace in {capital}; the ministries take their orders from the usurpers' council; the provinces are no longer answering the Chancellery.

Under Protocol ZERO this terminal is being purged. All command authority is revoked. Cryptographic keys are being destroyed.

There is no further action available.

>> SESSION TERMINATED <<
